title: Bead Stills
eyebrow: GPOM scene A · Maddie's hologram · bead stills
heading: Three small pictures inside the beads
intro: Each of these plays small, inside a glowing round bead, under one line of the hologram. Judge them as a circle in the middle of the square: one clear action, readable at thumbnail size. Four different ideas per picture (the look is the variable: a = the second half's 1980s BBC 16mm, the others break it). Stills only: no video credit spent. Pick one per row and leave a note.

sections.lede: Under: "For example: Derek picks toast, not cereal." The viewer hasn't met him yet; he must read as an ordinary bloke and be the Derek of the toilet row (SB07c).

groups.title: Derek picks toast
groups.line: Recommended: b (hand between the bread and the box, his face right above it; reads instantly in a circle)

opts.label: a: 16mm BBC, the whole dithering pose in a run-down kitchen
b: close on the choice, hand between bread and box, soft cream background
c: warm low morning sun, an old photo print; he smiles at his own dithering
opts.warn: Off-centre for a circle; the box was cleaned of a real brand in an edit

opts.label: d: breaks the look: advert-bright primary colours, eeny-meeny finger

sections.lede: Under: "Sandra decided to say sorry first, even though it wasn't her fault." Recognisably SB07b's Sandra.

groups.title: Sandra says sorry first
groups.line: Recommended: a (her reach toward his green-jumper shoulder is the apology in one gesture; cast from her Flow character)

opts.label: a: 16mm BBC front room, the anger draining, her hand reaching to his shoulder
b: big close-up, wet eyes, mouth opening on 'sorry'
opts.warn: Strong face, but may read as grief rather than an apology

opts.label: c: seen from the hallway, her hand on his folded arm, his back to us
opts.warn: Faces small: weak inside a bead

opts.label: d: breaks the look: night, one lamp, like an oil painting, her open hand held out

sections.lede: Under: "They got married." A modest, happy, real UK wedding.

groups.title: They got married
groups.line: Recommended: a (both faces hold, centred, confetti; matches the 16mm). Close second: d

opts.label: a: 16mm BBC, registry office steps, both laughing in confetti
b: his face, grinning at her; she has her back to us
opts.warn: A stray child's head in the foreground

opts.label: c: wide from across a wet street, friends throwing confetti
opts.warn: The couple are small: weak inside a bead

opts.label: d: breaks the look: disposable-camera flash at the pub reception, pint and sausage rolls
